title: 1800 case: balls of light come out of the water

tellings.quote: This case dates back to 1800. Balls of light emerging from the water, hovering alongside the craft, following the craft, and then taking off into the clouds.

plain: In a case from 1800, balls of light are said to have come up out of the sea, hovered beside a ship, followed it, and then shot up into the clouds. A researcher named Kevin Knuth tells this to Michels without naming his source, as evidence that such sightings go back long before aircraft existed.
